emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: The addresses to check. One row per address comes back, with a verdict or with the reason it could not be checked.

checkDns.title: Check the domain in DNS
checkDns.description: Ask a public resolver for the MX record of each domain. Turn it off to get only the format verdict, which costs nothing.

maxEmails.title: Max addresses
maxEmails.description: How many addresses one run checks. The rest come back as free status rows with the reason maxEmails.
